historical_normalization_rule_summary: Category strings as stored, bytes decoded where necessary; membership by exact Python string equality; no whitespace stripping; no case normalization; no alias or synonym mapping; no Ensembl remapping; no punctuation normalization. Non-targeting removed by exact case-sensitive equality to the single literal 'non-targeting', applied during set construction. Counting unit: constructs; constructs not de-duplicated by gene.
